lines.description:
ADVANCE PAYMENT — 75% OF THE CONTRACT VALUE
First instalment against our approved quotation QUT/DCTS/SQ145/2026 for the supply, installation, testing and commissioning of:
1. CHILLER ROOM — internal 3.00 x 3.00 x 2.40 m (21.60 cbm) at 0 °C to +8 °C, 100 mm PUF sandwich panel to walls, ceiling and floor (46.80 sqm), insulated floor system of 100 mm PUF floor panel with 18 mm marine plywood and 1.5 mm MS chequered plate (9.00 sqm), one (1) hinged door 900 x 1900 mm, one (1) 2 HP air-cooled condensing unit with matching evaporating unit on R404A, copper piping, Armaflex insulation, expansion valve, filter drier, sight glass and insulated drain line, digital control panel with all safeties, internal LED lighting, door frame heater and electrical works, and all coving, angles, sealing and accessories.
2. FREEZER ROOM — internal 3.00 x 3.00 x 2.40 m (21.60 cbm) at -18 °C to -22 °C, specification as above with a 2.5 HP air-cooled condensing unit and matching evaporating unit, and in addition a solenoid valve, electric defrost and an insulated drain line with heating tape.
3. Testing, commissioning, transportation, mobilisation, lifting at site and handover with operation training.
Contract value QAR 52,000.00 — this invoice covers the 75% advance.

notes: ACCOUNT POSITION. Contract value QAR 52,000.00 — sub-total QAR 61,250.00 less the special discount of QAR 9,250.00 — payable, as clause 13 of our approved quotation provides, 75% in advance, 20% on delivery of materials at site and 5% after successful testing, commissioning and handover. This invoice: 75% advance QAR 39,000.00. To follow: 20% QAR 10,400.00 on delivery of materials, and 5% QAR 2,600.00 on handover.

EQUIPMENT MAKES. As note 3 of our quotation provides, the condensing units are Danfoss (Denmark) or Tecumseh (France) and the evaporating units Gunay (Turkey) or Tecumseh (France), the make in each case as available at the time of order. The duty, capacity and specification are as quoted whichever make is supplied, and we shall confirm the makes and models to you in writing once the equipment is ordered.

PROGRAMME. Material delivery 3 to 5 days from the approved advance payment, site mobilisation within 3 working days of material arrival, installation 8 to 12 working days on a civil-ready site, and testing and commissioning 1 to 2 working days thereafter — 16 to 20 days in all, subject to site readiness. The programme runs from the receipt of this advance.

SITE READINESS. Please ensure the room positions are clear, level and accessible, and that the main power supply and the cable runs from the main distribution board to the two cold room control panels are available, together with drainage points within 3 m of each evaporator, as these are by others under our quotation. Final room dimensions will be confirmed on site before fabrication, and any change arising will be advised to you in writing, with its effect on the price and the programme, before the work is done.

THE FREEZER DRAIN AND DEFROST ARE INCLUDED. The freezer room is supplied with electric defrost and an insulated drain line with heating tape, and both rooms are supplied with an insulated floor system. Please note that the drain heating tape must remain powered at all times for the freezer drain to run; it is on the same supply as the room and should not be isolated separately.

Payment due on presentation of this invoice. Payment may be made by cheque or bank transfer to the account shown above; cheques to be crossed "A/C Payee Only" and drawn strictly in favour of the account name given, which is THE NEW DOHA KITCHEN EQUIPMENT SERVICES W.L.L. with no word between Equipment and Services. Kindly quote invoice INV-305/2026 as the reference.

WARRANTY: twelve (12) months on the cold room panels, the doors and our workmanship from the date of handover, and twelve (12) months on the compressors, the evaporator and condenser coils, the electrical components and the controls from the date of commissioning. Excludes damage from misuse, power surge, improper voltage, water ingress, unauthorised modification or the absence of routine maintenance.
We thank you for this order and for your confidence, and we look forward to completing the works to your satisfaction.
